المحاضرة 3 · ورقة مراجعة

الفصل 3: HTML 1 — مقدمة

HTML تصف معنى المحتوى وبنيته؛ أساس كل صفحة ويب، ومفتاح الإتاحة ومحركات البحث.

01 نظرة عامة

ما موضوع المحاضرة؟

الفصل 3 من كتاب Connolly & Hoar: HTML 1: مقدمة. تاريخ HTML (من 1991 إلى HTML5)، صياغة العناصر والوسوم والخصائص، التداخل وDOM، الترميز الدلالي ومزاياه، بنية مستند HTML5 (DOCTYPE، html، head، body)، جولة في العناصر (عناوين، فقرات، روابط بأنواعها، مراجع نسبية ومطلقة، عناصر مضمنة، صور، كيانات، قوائم)، وعناصر HTML5 الدلالية (header، nav، main، section، article، figure، aside، footer، details/summary، blockquote، address).

Chapter 3 of Connolly & Hoar: HTML 1: Introduction. HTML's history (1991 to HTML5), element/tag/attribute syntax, nesting and the DOM, semantic markup and its advantages, HTML5 document structure (DOCTYPE, html, head, body), a tour of elements (headings, paragraphs, kinds of links, relative and absolute references, inline elements, images, entities, lists), and HTML5 semantic elements (header, nav, main, section, article, figure, aside, footer, details/summary, blockquote, address).

الفكرة الأساسية

HTML تصف ماذا يعني المحتوى (عنوان، فقرة، قائمة، مقال، تنقل)، لا كيف يبدو؛ والشكل مهمة CSS. هذا الفصل بين المعنى والشكل هو ما يجعل الصفحات قابلة للصيانة وسريعة ومتاحة لقارئات الشاشة ومفهومة لمحركات البحث.

HTML describes what content means (heading, paragraph, list, article, navigation), not how it looks; looks are CSS's job. That separation is what makes pages maintainable, fast, accessible to screen readers and understandable to search engines.

قائمة المفاهيم الأساسية

  • لغة الترميز وتاريخ HTML (3–7)
  • العنصر، الوسم، الخاصية، العنصر الفارغ (8–9)
  • التداخل وDOM (10–11)
  • الترميز الدلالي ومزاياه (12–13)
  • DOCTYPE، html، head، body، title (14–20)
  • عناوين، فقرات، div، hr (21–27)
  • الروابط وأنواعها والمراجع النسبية (28–34)
  • العناصر المضمنة (35–36)
  • img والكيانات (37–39)
  • القوائم (40)
  • عناصر HTML5 الدلالية (41–46)
  • Markup language and HTML history (3–7)
  • Element, tag, attribute, empty element (8–9)
  • Nesting and the DOM (10–11)
  • Semantic markup and its advantages (12–13)
  • DOCTYPE, html, head, body, title (14–20)
  • Headings, paragraphs, div, hr (21–27)
  • Links, their kinds, relative references (28–34)
  • Inline elements (35–36)
  • img and entities (37–39)
  • Lists (40)
  • HTML5 semantic elements (41–46)

المهارات المكتسبة

  • كتابة مستند HTML5 صالح من الصفر.
  • تحديد العلاقات في شجرة DOM.
  • بناء أي رابط نسبي بين ملفين في شجرة مجلدات.
  • اختيار العنصر الدلالي المناسب بدل div.
  • كتابة img بخاصية alt مفيدة.
  • Write a valid HTML5 document from scratch.
  • Name relationships in a DOM tree.
  • Build any relative link between two files in a folder tree.
  • Pick the right semantic element instead of div.
  • Write img with a useful alt.

لماذا يهم؟

HTML أساس كل صفحة. والدلالة الصحيحة تخدم المكفوفين (عناوين وalt)، ومحركات البحث، وتسهل عمل CSS وJavaScript لاحقًا.

HTML underlies every page. Correct semantics serve blind users (headings, alt), search engines, and make later CSS and JavaScript easier.

الشريحة 03 — What Is HTML and Where Did It Come From?

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • HTML is defined as a markup language. A markup language is simply a way of annotating a document in such a way as to make the annotations distinct from the text being annotated.
  • You may very well have been the recipient of markup from caring parents or concerned teachers at various points in your past

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

Sticky notes: “Main heading”, “Second heading” (×2), “Bulleted”, “Code”, “Seriously??”, “Margin note? grey background?”, “this is NOT up to grade three standards.”

Handwritten page: “Once upon a time, a big bad robot was walking up a hill when he saw a blue car. It was a fast car” with corrections “Wrong!”, “No!”, “seriously?”.

[Handwriting is partly hard to read; transcription is best-effort.]

🖼 إظهار وصف الإتاحة

إتاحة — وصف الصورة

صورة لورقتين على خلفية فلين: ورقة مطبوعة عليها ملاحظات صفراء تسمي أجزاءها، وورقة مخططة بخط اليد عليها تصحيحات حمراء.
A photo of two sheets on a cork background: a printed page with yellow notes naming its parts, and a lined handwritten page with red corrections.

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. HTML is defined as a markup language. A markup language is simply a way of annotating a document in such a way as to make the annotations distinct from the text being annotated.

    HTML لغة ترميز: طريقة لإضافة «تعليقات» على المستند تكون منفصلة عن النص نفسه.

    HTML is a markup language: a way of annotating a document so the annotations stay distinct from the text.

  2. You may very well have been the recipient of markup from caring parents or concerned teachers at various points in your past

    ربما تلقيت «ترميزًا» من معلم صحح ورقتك.

    You've probably received “markup” from a teacher correcting your work.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الصورة: ورقة مطبوعة وأخرى مكتوبة بخط اليد عليها ملاحظات لاصقة صفراء (Main heading، Second heading، Bulleted، Code، Margin note) وتصحيحات حمراء (Wrong!، No!، seriously?). هذه الملاحظات هي «الترميز»: معلومات عن النص وليست النص نفسه، تمامًا كوسوم HTML.

The image: a printed page and a handwritten page covered in yellow sticky notes (Main heading, Second heading, Bulleted, Code, Margin note) and red corrections (Wrong!, No!, seriously?). Those notes are the “markup”: information about the text, not the text itself, just like HTML tags.

الخلاصة

الترميز = معلومات عن المحتوى منفصلة عنه.
Markup = information about content, kept separate from it.

الشريحة 04 — HTML Markup Language

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • At its simplest, markup is a way to indicate information about the content that is distinct from the content.
  • This “information about content” in HTML is implemented via tags (or more formally, HTML elements, but more on that later).
  • Since the initial HTML specification in 1991, HTML has gone through many interesting changes worth understanding in brief.
  • XHTML 2

الشريحة 05 — Early HTML

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Initial implementation of HTML and HTTP between 1990 and 1991 by Tim Berners-Lee and Robert Cailliau
  • HTML’s formal codification by the World Wide Web Consortium (better known as the W3C) between 1995 and 1997
  • “browser wars” in the mid 1990s between Netscape Navigator and Microsoft Internet Explorer motivated many new tags and features such as CSS and JavaScript, but the development of new features happened quickly, and interoperability between browsers became a major issue
  • In 1998 the W3C froze the HTML specification at version 4.01
  • XHTML 2

    W3C قننت HTML رسميًا بين 1995 و1997.

  3. “browser wars” in the mid 1990s between Netscape Navigator and Microsoft Internet Explorer motivated many new tags and features such as CSS and JavaScript, but … interoperability between browsers became a major issue

    «حرب المتصفحات» بين نتسكيب وإنترنت إكسبلورر أضافت ميزات كثيرة (CSS، JavaScript) لكن سببت مشاكل توافق.

    The 1990s “browser wars” (Netscape vs IE) added features like CSS and JavaScript but caused interoperability problems.

الشريحة 06 — XHTML

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • In the late 1990s the W3C developed o a new specification called XHTML 1.0, which was a version of HTML that used stricter XML
  • The goal of XHTML with its strict rules was to make page rendering more predictable by forcing web authors to create web pages without syntax errors.
  • To help web authors, two versions of XHTML were created:
    • XHTML 1.0 Strict and
    • XHTML 1.0 Transitional.
  • Development on the XHTML 2.0 specification dragged on for many years
  • XHTML 2

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. In the late 1990s the W3C developed o a new specification called XHTML 1.0, which was a version of HTML that used stricter XML

    أواخر التسعينيات: XHTML 1.0، نسخة من HTML بقواعد XML الصارمة. (حرف «o» زائد في الشريحة.)

    Late 1990s: XHTML 1.0, HTML with strict XML rules. (A stray “o” is on the slide.)

  2. The goal of XHTML with its strict rules was to make page rendering more predictable by forcing web authors to create web pages without syntax errors.

    الهدف: عرض متوقع بإجبار المؤلفين على كتابة بلا أخطاء.

    The goal: predictable rendering by forcing error-free pages.

  3. …two versions of XHTML were created: XHTML 1.0 Strict and XHTML 1.0 Transitional.

    نسختان: Strict وTransitional (انتقالية أسهل).

    Two versions: Strict and Transitional (an easier bridge).

  4. Development on the XHTML 2.0 specification dragged on for many years

    تطوير XHTML 2.0 تعثر سنوات.

    XHTML 2.0 dragged on for years.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

صرامة XHTML: كل وسم يُغلق، أحرف صغيرة، قيم الخصائص بين علامات تنصيص، والعناصر الفارغة تنتهي بـ /> (الشريحة 9).

XHTML strictness: every tag closed, lowercase, quoted attribute values, and empty elements ending in /> (slide 9).

الخلاصة

XHTML = HTML بقواعد XML صارمة.
XHTML = HTML with strict XML rules.

الشريحة 07 — HTML5

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • While the XHTML 2.0 specification was being developed, a small group of developers at Opera and Mozilla formed the WHATWG (Web Hypertext Application Technology Working Group).
  • By 2009, the W3C stopped work on XHTML 2.0 and instead adopted the work done by WHATWG and named it HTML5.
  • There are three main aims to HTML5:
    • Specify unambiguously how browsers should deal with invalid markup.
    • Provide an open, nonproprietary programming framework (via JavaScript) for creating rich web applications.
    • Be backward compatible with the existing web.
  • XHTML 2

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. While the XHTML 2.0 specification was being developed, a small group of developers at Opera and Mozilla formed the WHATWG…

    مطورون من Opera وMozilla أسسوا WHATWG.

    Developers at Opera and Mozilla formed the WHATWG.

  2. By 2009, the W3C stopped work on XHTML 2.0 and instead adopted the work done by WHATWG and named it HTML5.

    2009 أوقفت W3C مشروع XHTML 2.0 وتبنت عمل WHATWG باسم HTML5.

    In 2009 the W3C dropped XHTML 2.0 and adopted WHATWG's work as HTML5.

  3. Specify unambiguously how browsers should deal with invalid markup.

    هدف 1: تحديد واضح لكيفية تعامل المتصفح مع الترميز الخاطئ.

    Aim 1: say unambiguously how browsers handle invalid markup.

  4. Provide an open, nonproprietary programming framework (via JavaScript) for creating rich web applications.

    هدف 2: إطار برمجي مفتوح (JavaScript) لتطبيقات غنية.

    Aim 2: an open JavaScript framework for rich apps.

  5. Be backward compatible with the existing web.

    هدف 3: التوافق مع الويب الموجود.

    Aim 3: backward compatibility.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الفرق الفلسفي: XHTML تقول «اكتب بلا أخطاء وإلا»، وHTML5 تقول «الأخطاء ستحدث، فلنحدد كيف نتعامل معها».

The philosophical difference: XHTML says “write without errors or else”; HTML5 says “errors will happen, so let's define how to handle them”.

الخلاصة

HTML5 (2009) من WHATWG: 3 أهداف.
HTML5 (2009) from WHATWG: 3 aims.

الشريحة 08 — HTML Syntax

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • HTML documents are composed of content and HTML elements.
  • An HTML element is identified in the HTML document by tags.
    • A tag consists of the element name within angle brackets.
  • The element name appears in both the opening tag and the closing tag.
  • HTML elements can also contain attributes. An HTML attribute is a name=value pair that provides more information about the element

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<a href="http://www.centralpark.com">Central Park</a>

Labels: Opening tag (over <a href="…">) · Closing tag (over </a>) · Element name (a) · Attribute (href="http://www.centralpark.com") · Content (Central Park)

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. HTML documents are composed of content and HTML elements.

    المستند = محتوى + عناصر.

    A document = content + elements.

  2. An HTML element is identified in the HTML document by tags. A tag consists of the element name within angle brackets.

    العنصر يُعرف بوسوم؛ الوسم = اسم العنصر بين < >.

    An element is marked by tags; a tag = element name in < >.

  3. The element name appears in both the opening tag and the closing tag.

    الاسم في وسم الفتح والإغلاق.

    The name appears in opening and closing tags.

  4. HTML elements can also contain attributes. An HTML attribute is a name=value pair…

    الخاصية: زوج name=value يعطي معلومات إضافية.

    An attribute is a name=value pair adding information.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

في المثال: a اسم العنصر، href="…" خاصية، «Central Park» المحتوى، و</a> وسم الإغلاق.

In the example: a is the element name, href="…" the attribute, “Central Park” the content, and </a> the closing tag.

الخلاصة

عنصر = وسم فتح (اسم + خصائص) + محتوى + وسم إغلاق.
Element = opening tag (name + attributes) + content + closing tag.

الشريحة 09 — Empty Element

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • An empty element does not contain any text content; instead, it is an instruction to the browser to do something.
  • Perhaps the most common empty element is <img>, the image element.
  • In XHTML, empty elements had to be terminated by a trailing slash (as shown in image). In HTML5, the trailing slash in empty elements is optional.

<img src="file.gif" alt="something" />

Labels: Example empty element · Element name (img) · Trailing slash (optional)

  1. An empty element does not contain any text content; instead, it is an instruction to the browser to do something.

    العنصر الفارغ بلا محتوى نصي؛ هو أمر للمتصفح.

    An empty element has no text; it's an instruction to the browser.

  2. Perhaps the most common empty element is <img>, the image element.

    أشهره <img>.

    The commonest is <img>.

  3. In XHTML, empty elements had to be terminated by a trailing slash … In HTML5, the trailing slash in empty elements is optional.

    في XHTML يجب / في النهاية؛ في HTML5 اختيارية.

    XHTML required a trailing slash; HTML5 makes it optional.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

عناصر فارغة أخرى (إضافي): <br>، <hr>، <meta>، <link>.

Other empty elements (additional): <br>, <hr>, <meta>, <link>.

الشريحة 10 — Nesting HTML Elements

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Often an HTML element will contain other HTML elements. In such a case, the container element is said to be a parent of the contained, or child, element.
  • Any elements contained within the child are said to be descendants of the parent element; likewise, any given child element may have a variety of ancestors.
  • This concept is called the Document Object Model (DOM) formally, though for now we will only refer to its hierarchical aspects.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<body>
   <p>
   This is some <strong>text</strong>
   </p>
   <h1>Title goes here</h1>
   <div>
      <p>
      This is <span>important</span>
      </p>
   </div>
</body>

Code labels: Ancestor, Parent, Child, Sibling, Descendants.

Tree: <body> → children <p>, <h1>, <div> (Siblings); <p> → <strong>; <div> → <p> → <span>. Side arrows: Descendants (down), Children (down), Ancestors (up).

🖼 إظهار وصف الإتاحة

مخطط معاد بناؤه

body
├── p
│   └── strong
├── h1
└── div
    └── p
        └── span

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Often an HTML element will contain other HTML elements. In such a case, the container element is said to be a parent of the contained, or child, element.

    العنصر الحاوي «أب»، والمحتوى «ابن».

    The container is the parent; the contained element is the child.

  2. Any elements contained within the child are said to be descendants of the parent element; likewise, any given child element may have a variety of ancestors.

    ما بداخل الابن «أحفاد» للأب، وللعنصر «أسلاف».

    Elements inside the child are descendants; elements above are ancestors.

  3. This concept is called the Document Object Model (DOM) formally…

    هذا المفهوم هو DOM (نموذج كائن المستند).

    This is the Document Object Model (DOM).

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشجرة في الشكل: body أب لـ p وh1 وdiv (أخوة Siblings)؛ strong ابن لـ p؛ span حفيد لـ body عبر div ثم p.

The tree in the figure: body is parent of p, h1 and div (siblings); strong is a child of p; span is a descendant of body via div then p.

الخلاصة

علاقات DOM: أب، ابن، أخ، حفيد، سلف.
DOM relations: parent, child, sibling, descendant, ancestor.

الشريحة 11 — Correct Nesting

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • In order to properly construct this hierarchy of elements, your browser expects each HTML nested element to be properly nested.
  • A child’s ending tag must occur before its parent’s ending tag

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. …your browser expects each HTML nested element to be properly nested.

    المتصفح يتوقع تداخلًا صحيحًا.

    Browsers expect proper nesting.

  2. A child’s ending tag must occur before its parent’s ending tag

    وسم إغلاق الابن قبل وسم إغلاق الأب.

    A child's closing tag must come before its parent's.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

القاعدة: «آخر من يُفتح أول من يُغلق»، مثل الأقواس في الرياضيات ( [ ] ).

The rule: last opened, first closed, like brackets in maths ( [ ] ).

الخلاصة

أغلق الابن قبل الأب.
Close the child before the parent.

الشريحة 12 — Semantic Markup

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • HTML documents should only focus on the structure of the document
  • Figure 3.7
  • Information about how the content should look is best left to CSS (Cascading Style Sheets), a topic introduced in the next chapter
  • As a consequence, beginning HTML authors are often counseled to create semantic HTML documents.
  • HTML document should not describe how to visually present content but only describe its content’s structural semantics or meaning

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. HTML documents should only focus on the structure of the document

    HTML للبنية فقط.

    HTML is for structure only.

  2. Figure 3.7

    إشارة إلى الشكل 3.7 في الكتاب (رابط في الشريحة، دون صورة).

    A reference to Figure 3.7 in the book (a link on the slide, no image).

  3. Information about how the content should look is best left to CSS…

    المظهر لـ CSS.

    Appearance belongs to CSS.

  4. …beginning HTML authors are often counseled to create semantic HTML documents.

    يُنصح المبتدئون بـ HTML دلالي.

    Beginners are advised to write semantic HTML.

  5. HTML document should not describe how to visually present content but only describe its content’s structural semantics or meaning

    HTML لا تصف الشكل بل المعنى (مكتوبة بالأحمر في الشريحة للتأكيد).

    HTML must not describe looks, only meaning (in red on the slide for emphasis).

الشرح — شرح موسّع

مثال: استخدم <h2> لأنه عنوان فرعي، لا لأنك تريد خطًا كبيرًا؛ والخط الكبير تحدده CSS.

Example: use <h2> because it's a subheading, not because you want big text; size is CSS's job.

الخلاصة

HTML = المعنى، CSS = الشكل.
HTML = meaning, CSS = looks.

الشريحة 13 — Semantic Markup Advantages

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Maintainability. Semantic markup is easier to update and change than web pages that contain a great deal of presentation markup.
  • Performance. Semantic web pages are typically quicker to author and faster to download.
  • Accessibility. Not all web users are able to view the content on web pages. Users with sight disabilities experience the web using voice-reading software.
  • Search engine optimization. For many site owners, the most important users of a website are the various search engine crawlers.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Maintainability…

    سهولة الصيانة.

    Maintainability.

  2. Performance…

    أداء أسرع.

    Performance.

  3. Accessibility. … Users with sight disabilities experience the web using voice-reading software.

    الإتاحة: المكفوفون يستخدمون قارئات الشاشة.

    Accessibility: blind users rely on screen readers.

  4. Search engine optimization…

    تحسين محركات البحث.

    SEO.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

هذه الورقة نفسها مثال: العناوين الحقيقية h2 تسمح لقارئ NVDA بالتنقل بين الشرائح.

This very sheet is an example: real h2 headings let NVDA users jump between slides.

الخلاصة

4 مزايا: صيانة، أداء، إتاحة، SEO.

الشريحة 15 — The title element

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • P R O T I P
  • The <title> element plays an important role in search engine optimization (SEO),
  • that is, improving a page’s rank (its position in the results page after a search) .
  • While each search engine uses different algorithms for determining a page’s rank, the title (and the major headings) provides a key role in determining what a given page is about.
  • As a result, be sure that a page’s title text briefly summarizes the document’s
  • content. As well, put the most important content first in the title. Most browsers
  • limit the length of the title that is displayed in the tab or window title to about 60
  • characters. Chapter 18 goes into far greater detail on SEO.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

  2. …the title (and the major headings) provides a key role in determining what a given page is about.

    العنوان والعناوين الرئيسية تحدد موضوع الصفحة.

    The title and main headings tell engines what the page is about.

  3. …be sure that a page’s title text briefly summarizes the document’s content. … put the most important content first … about 60 characters.

    اجعله ملخصًا، والأهم أولًا، وحوالي 60 حرفًا.

    Make it a summary, most important first, about 60 characters.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

مثال جيد: «Share Your Travels -- New York - Central Park» (الشريحة 16): الموقع أولًا ثم الصفحة.

الخلاصة

الشريحة 21 — Quick Tour of HTML Elements

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Headings. Describes the main structure of document. There are six levels of headings.
  • Paragraphs. The basic unit of text in HTML. As block-level elements, browsers typically add newlines before and after the element.
  • Link. Hyperlinks are essential feature of all web pages and can reference another page or another location in same page.
  • Inline Text Elements. These do not change the flow of text and provide more information about text.
  • Image. Used to display an image by specifying a filename or URL.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<body>
   <h1>Share Your Travels</h1>                                       (1)
   <h2>Venice - Grand Canal</h2>
   <p>Photo by Randy Connolly</p>                                    (2)
   <p>This view of the Grand Canal in
      <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Venice">Venice</a>      (3)
      was taken from the <strong>Ponte di Rialto</strong>.           (4)
   </p>
   <img src="images/venice.jpg" alt="Venice" />                      (5)
   <ul>                                                              (6)
      <li>Photo by <em>Randy Connolly</em></li>
      <li>Take on June 23, 2017</li>
   </ul>
   <h3>Reviews</h3>
   <div>                                                             (7)
      <p>By Hypatia on <time>2019-10-23</time></p>
      <p>I love Venice in the morning.</p>
   </div>
   <hr>                                                              (8)
   <div>
      <p>By Curia on <time>2019-12-11</time></p>
      <p>I want to visit Venice!</p>
   </div>
   <footer>Copyright &copy; 2020 Share Your Travels</footer>         (9) (10)
</body>

    5 الصورة.

    5 images.

الشريحة 22 — Quick Tour of HTML Elements (cont)

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Unordered List. Used to display a bulleted list. Within a list is a collection of list item elements.
  • Division. Container for text or other HTML elements. Like paragraphs, they are also block-level elements.
  • Horizontal Rule. Indicates a thematic break in the text. Usually displayed as a horizontal line.
  • Character Entity. The mechanism for including special symbols (such as ©) or characters that have a reserved meaning in HTML.
  • Semantic Block Element. Special containers in HTML5 for describing structural elements in a document.

الشريحة 25 — Headings

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • HTML provides six levels of heading (h1 through h6)
  • They are an essential way for document authors to show their readers the structure of the document
  • Headings are also used by the browser to create a document outline for the page.
  • Choose the heading level because it is appropriate semantically NOT because of its default presentation (e.g., choosing <h3> because you want your text to be bold and 16pt).

الشريحة 31 — Absolute and Relative URLs

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • When referencing a page or resource on an external site, a full absolute URL reference is required
  • Full URL with a protocol (typically, http:// or https://), the domain name, any paths, and the file name of the desired resource.
  • When referencing a resource that is on the same server, you can use relative referencing.
  • If the URL does not include the “http://” then the browser will request the current server for the file.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. When referencing a page or resource on an external site, a full absolute URL reference is required

    للمواقع الخارجية: URL مطلق كامل.

  2. Full URL with a protocol (typically, http:// or https://), the domain name, any paths, and the file name…

    يشمل البروتوكول والنطاق والمسار والملف.

    Protocol, domain, path and file.

  3. When referencing a resource that is on the same server, you can use relative referencing.

    لنفس الخادم: مرجع نسبي.

    Same server: relative reference.

  4. If the URL does not include the “http://” then the browser will request the current server for the file.

    بدون http:// يطلب المتصفح من نفس الخادم.

    Without http:// the browser asks the current server.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الخلاصة

مطلق للخارج، نسبي للداخل.
Absolute for external, relative for internal.

الشريحة 32 — Relative URLs

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Same Directory To link to a file within the same folder, simply use the file name.
  • Child Directory To link to a file within a subdirectory, use the name of the subdirectory and a slash before the file name.
  • Grandchild/Descendant Directory To link to a file that is multiple subdirectories below the current one, construct the full path by including each subdirectory name (separated by slashes) before the file name.
  • Parent/Ancestor Directory Use “../” to reference a folder above the current one. If trying to reference a file several levels above the current one, simply string together multiple “../”.
  • Sibling Directory Use “../” to move up to the appropriate level, and then use the same technique as for child or grandchild directories.
  • Root Reference In this approach, begin the reference with the root reference (the “/”), and then use the same technique as for child or grandchild directories.
  • See Table 3.1 for examples (p. 97)

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Character entities are special characters for symbols for which there is either no easy way to type them via a keyboard or which have a reserved meaning in HTML (for instance the “<” or “>” symbols).
  • They can be used in an HTML document by using the entity name or the entity number

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Character entities are special characters for symbols for which there is either no easy way to type them via a keyboard or which have a reserved meaning in HTML (for instance the “<” or “>” symbols).

    الكيانات الحرفية لرموز يصعب كتابتها أو لها معنى محجوز مثل < >.

    Entities are for symbols hard to type or reserved in HTML like < >.

  2. They can be used in an HTML document by using the entity name or the entity number

    بالاسم أو بالرقم.

    By name or by number.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

لماذا &lt;؟ لأن كتابة < مباشرة سيظنها المتصفح بداية وسم.

Why &lt;? Writing < directly would look like the start of a tag.

الخلاصة

&name; أو &#number;
&name; or &#number;

الشريحة 40 — Lists

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Ordered lists Collections of items that have a set order
    • <ol> <li>
  • Unordered Lists Collections of items in no particular order
  • <ul> <li>
  • Description Lists Collection of name and description/definition pairs.
  • <dl> <dt><dd>

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<ul>
   <li><a href="index.html">Home</a></li>

   <li>Products</li>
   <li>Contact Us</li>
</ul>
<ol>
   <li>Introduction</li>
   <li>Background</li>
   <li>My Solution</li>
   <li>
      <ol>
         <li>Methodology</li>
         <li>Results</li>
         <li>Discussion</li>
      </ol>
   </li>
   <li>Conclusion</li>
</ol>

Note in figure: Notice that the list item element can contain other HTML elements.

Browser output (listing02-09.html): • Home • About Us • Products • Contact Us. (listing02-10.html): 1. Introduction 2. Background 3. My Solution — 1. Methodology 2. Results 3. Discussion — 4. Conclusion

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Ordered lists Collections of items that have a set order <ol> <li>

    مرتبة: <ol> و<li>.

    Ordered: <ol> and <li>.

  2. Unordered Lists Collections of items in no particular order <ul> <li>

    غير مرتبة: <ul> و<li>.

    Unordered: <ul> and <li>.

  3. Description Lists Collection of name and description/definition pairs. <dl> <dt><dd>

    وصفية: <dl> <dt> <dd> (الاسم والوصف).

    Description: <dl> <dt> <dd> (term and description).

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشكل يبين قائمة مرتبة متداخلة: عنصر li يمكن أن يحتوي قائمة كاملة أخرى (Methodology، Results، Discussion داخل My Solution). (<dd> مظلل بالأصفر في الشريحة.)

The figure shows a nested ordered list: an li can contain a whole list (Methodology, Results, Discussion inside My Solution). (<dd> is highlighted yellow on the slide.)

الخلاصة

ol مرتبة، ul غير مرتبة، dl وصفية.
ol ordered, ul unordered, dl description.

الشريحة 41 — HTML5 Semantic Structure

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • So far, the main semantic elements you have seen are headings, paragraphs, lists, some inline elements and the semantic block element, the division (i.e., <div> element).
  • HTML5 semantic elements allow to replace some of your <div> sprawl with cleaner and more self-explanatory elements

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<body>
<div id="header">                          -> (1) <header>
   <div id="top-navigation">               -> (2) <nav>
   </div>
</div>
<div id="main">                            -> (3) <main>
   <div id="left-navigation"> </div>
   <h1>Page Title</h1>
   <div class="content">                   -> (4) <section>
      <h2>Stories</h2>
      <div class="story"> ... </div>       -> (5) <article>
      <div class="story">
         <div class="story-photo">         -> (6) <figure>
            <img ... class="blog-photo"/>
            <p class="photo-caption">...   -> (7) <figcaption>
         </div>
      </div>
      <div class="related-stuff-on-right"> -> (8) <aside>
      </div>
   </div>
   <div class="content"> ... </div>
</div>
<div id="footer"> ... </div>               -> (9) <footer>
</body>

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. So far, the main semantic elements you have seen are headings, paragraphs, lists, some inline elements and the semantic block element, the division (i.e., <div> element).

    حتى الآن: عناوين، فقرات، قوائم، مضمنة، وdiv.

    So far: headings, paragraphs, lists, inline elements and div.

  2. HTML5 semantic elements allow to replace some of your <div> sprawl with cleaner and more self-explanatory elements

    HTML5 تستبدل «فوضى div» بعناصر تشرح نفسها.

    HTML5 replaces “div sprawl” with self-explanatory elements.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشكل: كل div بـ id أو class (header، top-navigation، main…) يقابله عنصر HTML5 بأيقونة درع: header، nav، main، section، article، figure، figcaption، aside، footer.

The figure: each div with an id or class (header, top-navigation, main…) maps to an HTML5 element with a shield icon: header, nav, main, section, article, figure, figcaption, aside, footer.

الخلاصة

div id="header" ← <header>، إلخ.
div id="header" → <header>, etc.

</body>

الشريحة 43 — Using Semantic Elements

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • HTML5 semantic elements do not apply any special presentation giving them great flexibility.
  • Article and section, for instance, can be used many ways when designing your website.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. HTML5 semantic elements do not apply any special presentation giving them great flexibility.

    لا تفرض شكلًا خاصًا، لذا مرنة.

    They impose no look, so they're flexible.

  2. Article and section, for instance, can be used many ways when designing your website.

    article وsection يُستخدمان بطرق كثيرة.

    article and section can be used many ways.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الرسم الأعلى: صفحة مقسمة إلى sections (فيديو، تعليقات، قائمة جانبية). الأسفل: صفحة فيها articles (مقال رئيسي وتعليقات كل منها article).

Top drawing: a page split into sections (video, comments, side list). Bottom: a page of articles (a main post and comments, each an article).

الخلاصة

section للتجميع الموضوعي، article للمحتوى المستقل.
section groups by theme; article is self-contained content.

الشريحة 44 — Figure and figcaption

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • The <figure> element can be used not just for images but for any type of essential content that could be moved to a different location in the page or document, and the rest of the document would still make sense.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<p>This photo was taken on October 22, 2011 with a Canon EOS 30D camera.</p>
<figure>
   <img src="images/central-park.jpg" alt="Central Park" /><br/>
   <figcaption>Conservatory Pond in Central Park</figcaption>
</figure>
<p>
It was a wonderfully beautiful autumn Sunday, with strong sunlight and
expressive clouds. I was very fortunate that my one day in New York was
blessed with such weather!
</p>

Notes in figure: “Figure could be moved to a different location in document … But it has to exist in the document (i.e., the figure isn't optional).”

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. The <figure> element can be used not just for images but for any type of essential content that could be moved to a different location in the page or document, and the rest of the document would still make sense.

    <figure> لأي محتوى أساسي يمكن نقله دون أن يفقد المستند معناه.

    <figure> is for any essential content that could be moved without the document losing sense.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشكل يوضح: الشكل يمكن نقله لمكان آخر، لكن يجب أن يبقى موجودًا (ليس اختياريًا). وfigcaption يعطيه تعليقًا مرتبطًا به دلاليًا.

The figure explains: a figure can move elsewhere but must still exist (it isn't optional). figcaption gives it a semantically linked caption.

الخلاصة

figure + figcaption = محتوى قابل للنقل مع تعليقه.
figure + figcaption = movable content with its caption.

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • For browsers that support these elements, accordion functionality is included as well (thus no JavaScript programming is required).

   </details>

      </p>

</body>

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. The <details> and <summary> elements provide a way of semantically relating a summary and a details.

    <details> و<summary> يربطان ملخصًا بتفاصيله.

    <details> and <summary> relate a summary to its details.

  2. For browsers that support these elements, accordion functionality is included as well (thus no JavaScript programming is required).

    يعطيان «أكورديون» قابلًا للطي بلا JavaScript.

    They give a collapsible accordion with no JavaScript.

هذه الورقة نفسها تستخدمهما في «إظهار وصف الإتاحة».

details/summary = طي بلا JS.
details/summary = collapsing without JS.

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. The <blockquote> element is a way to indicate a quotation from another source.

    <blockquote> لاقتباس من مصدر آخر.

    <blockquote> marks a quotation from another source.

  2. The <address> element indicates that the enclosed HTML contains contact information for a person or organization.

    <address> لمعلومات الاتصال.

    <address> holds contact information.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

ملاحظة على الكود كما هو: الرابط الأخير href="gettymuseum@getty.edu" بدون mailto:، فلن يفتح البريد بل سيُعامل كمسار ملف نسبي؛ الصحيح href="mailto:gettymuseum@getty.edu" (الشريحة 30).

A note on the code as printed: the last link href="gettymuseum@getty.edu" lacks mailto:, so it would be treated as a relative file path, not email; it should be href="mailto:gettymuseum@getty.edu" (slide 30).

blockquote للاقتباس، address للاتصال.
blockquote for quotes, address for contact info.

05 ثلاثة مستويات

  • HTML مثل ملصقات على صندوق: «هذا عنوان»، «هذه قائمة»؛ لا تحدد اللون ولا الحجم.
  • الوسم مثل قوسين: يُفتح <p> ويُغلق </p>.
  • DOM شجرة عائلة: body الجد، p الأب، strong الابن.
  • الرابط النسبي مثل وصف الطريق داخل نفس البيت: «اصعد طابقًا (../) ثم ادخل الغرفة».
  • عناصر HTML5 أسماء أوضح لأجزاء الصفحة: رأس، تنقل، رئيسي، جانبي، تذييل.
  • HTML is like labels on boxes: “this is a heading”, “this is a list”; it doesn't set colour or size.
  • A tag is like a pair of brackets: open <p>, close </p>.
  • The DOM is a family tree: body the grandparent, p the parent, strong the child.
  • A relative link is directions within the same house: “go up a floor (../), then into the room”.
  • HTML5 elements are clearer names for page parts: header, navigation, main, aside, footer.
  • HTML لغة ترميز؛ التطور: HTML 2/3.2/4.01 ← XHTML 1.0 (Strict/Transitional، قواعد XML) ← HTML5 (WHATWG، 2009) بأهداف: معالجة محددة للترميز الخاطئ، إطار JavaScript مفتوح، توافق رجعي.
  • العنصر = tag + attributes (name=value) + content؛ العناصر الفارغة (img، br، hr، meta، link).
  • DOM شجرة: parent/child/sibling/descendant/ancestor؛ التداخل الصحيح LIFO.
  • المستند: DOCTYPE (standards vs quirks)، html[lang]، head (meta charset، title، link، script)، body.
  • المراجع: مطلقة (scheme://host/path) أو نسبية (same، child، descendant، ../، sibling، /root، default document).
  • الدلالة: عناصر كتلية ومضمنة؛ عناصر HTML5 البنيوية لا تحمل تنسيقًا افتراضيًا خاصًا؛ figure لمحتوى قابل للنقل؛ details/summary أكورديون أصلي.
  • HTML is a markup language; evolution: HTML 2/3.2/4.01 → XHTML 1.0 (Strict/Transitional, XML rules) → HTML5 (WHATWG, 2009) with aims: defined handling of invalid markup, an open JavaScript framework, backward compatibility.
  • Element = tag + attributes (name=value) + content; empty elements (img, br, hr, meta, link).
  • The DOM is a tree: parent/child/sibling/descendant/ancestor; correct nesting is LIFO.
  • Document: DOCTYPE (standards vs quirks), html[lang], head (meta charset, title, link, script), body.
  • References: absolute (scheme://host/path) or relative (same, child, descendant, ../, sibling, /root, default document).
  • Semantics: block vs inline; HTML5 structural elements carry no special default styling; figure for movable content; details/summary is a native accordion.
  • 1991 HTML؛ 1995–97 W3C؛ 1998 HTML 4.01؛ XHTML 1.0؛ 2009 HTML5.
  • <a href="…">label</a>
  • img فارغ، / اختيارية.
  • أغلق الابن قبل الأب.
  • HTML = معنى، CSS = شكل.
  • DOCTYPE ← html ← head ← body.
  • title ~60 حرفًا.
  • h1–h6 للمعنى.
  • #top + id="top".
  • mailto، tel، sms.
  • ../ صعود، / جذر.
  • alt إلزامي عمليًا للإتاحة.
  • < > ©  
  • ol، ul، dl (dt/dd).
  • header، nav، main، section، article، figure، figcaption، aside، footer.
  • 1991 HTML; 1995–97 W3C; 1998 HTML 4.01; XHTML 1.0; 2009 HTML5.
  • <a href="…">label</a>
  • img is empty; / optional.
  • Close the child before the parent.
  • HTML = meaning, CSS = looks.
  • DOCTYPE → html → head → body.
  • title ~60 chars.
  • h1–h6 for meaning.
  • #top + id="top".
  • mailto, tel, sms.
  • ../ up, / root.
  • alt is practically mandatory for accessibility.
  • < > ©  
  • ol, ul, dl (dt/dd).
  • header, nav, main, section, article, figure, figcaption, aside, footer.

06 اختبار تفاعلي

النتيجة 0/30

    07 نصائح احترافية

    كيف تفهم بدل أن تحفظ

    • اكتب صفحة الشريحة 21 بنفسك وافتحها في المتصفح.
    • ارسم شجرة DOM لأي صفحة صغيرة تكتبها.
    • أنشئ مجلدات الشريحة 32 فعليًا وجرّب كل رابط نسبي.
    • لكل div في صفحتك اسأل: هل يوجد عنصر HTML5 أوضح؟
    • جرّب صفحتك بقارئ شاشة (NVDA) وتنقل بالعناوين.
    • Type slide 21's page yourself and open it in a browser.
    • Draw the DOM tree of any small page you write.
    • Create slide 32's folders for real and test every relative link.
    • For each div ask: is there a clearer HTML5 element?
    • Try your page with a screen reader (NVDA) and navigate by headings.

    تمارين عملية مقترحة

    1. صفحة عن مدينتك فيها: h1، فقرتان، صورة بـ alt، قائمة مرتبة، رابط خارجي، رابط #top.
    2. حوّل كود الشريحة 41 (div) إلى عناصر HTML5.
    3. استخدم details/summary لصفحة أسئلة شائعة.
    4. تحقق من صفحتك بأداة W3C Validator.
    1. A page about your city with: h1, two paragraphs, an image with alt, an ordered list, an external link, a #top link.
    2. Convert slide 41's div code into HTML5 elements.
    3. Use details/summary for an FAQ page.
    4. Validate your page with the W3C Validator.

    أخطاء شائعة

    • اختيار h3 لأنه «أصغر» لا لأنه المستوى الصحيح.
    • إغلاق الأب قبل الابن.
    • نسيان alt في الصور.
    • نسيان mailto: في روابط البريد.
    • الخلط بين ../ و/.
    • استخدام div لكل شيء بدل العناصر الدلالية.
    • كتابة < مباشرة بدل &lt;.
    • Picking h3 because it's “smaller”, not because it's the right level.
    • Closing the parent before the child.
    • Forgetting alt on images.
    • Forgetting mailto: on email links.
    • Mixing up ../ and /.
    • Using div for everything instead of semantic elements.
    • Typing < directly instead of &lt;.
